question: Who among the following has written the book ‘A century is not enough: my roller coaster ride to success’?
solution:
The corrcet answer is __**Sourav Ganguly.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A Century is Not Enough:** My Roller-coaster Ride to Success (2018) is an English autobiography written by former Indian cricketer and captain Sourav Ganguly with Gautam Bhattacharya
 
• The book was first published by Juggernaut **on 24 February 2018.**
 
• In this book, Ganguly discussed his cricketing career in detail. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kapil Dev Ramlal Nikhanj** is an Indian former cricketer.
 
• Kapil Dev's latest book title The Sikhs were released in 2019.
 
• Ravishankar Jayadritha Shastri is the former head coach of the India national cricket team, a cricket commentator, and a former captain of the Indian Cricket Team.
